sources.note: Main website. Cloud-based EHR for clinics and hospitals. Lists modules: Clinical EHR, ASC, Behavioral Health, Residential Treatment, Billing/PM, Telemedicine, Patient Portal. Bedminster, NJ.
ONC mandatory disclosures page. Lists certified criteria, product version 2.1, certification date 2022-02-15. No pricing details.

About page. Headquartered at 90 Washington Valley Rd, Bedminster, NJ. SaaS model. Emphasizes no-cost customization. No company history, size, or customer count disclosed. Established circa 2013 per metadata.
Clinical EHR product page. ONC-certified with scheduling, e-prescribing, documentation, lab integration. Lists modules: EPCS, Patient Portal, Telemedicine, Kiosk, Consent Module, Custom API.
ASC module page. Sparse on detail — mentions scheduling, reports, customizable modules, and secure support. No specifics on surgical workflows or anesthesia documentation.
Workers Comp/No-Fault module page. Handles claims submissions, clinical notes, and billing with compliance. Limited detail on specific features.
Patient Portal page. Patients can manage records, schedule visits, message providers, and pay bills. HIPAA-compliant.
Residential Treatment Facility module page. Designed for addiction and mental health centers. Secure tracking, integrated scheduling, compliance support. Limited detail on specific workflows.
Behavioral Health EHR page (404 on direct fetch but referenced in search results). Mental health and substance abuse treatment documentation with customizable templates.
Blog post on integrations. Mentions lab interfaces, radiology interfaces, HIE connectivity, custom API. Unified patient data dashboard.

SoftwareFinder listing. Pricing details: Clinical $495/mo, ASC $750/OR/mo, Behavioral Health $65/user/mo, RTF $150/bed, Billing $150-250/mo. Integrations: Optum, Waystar, Surescripts, Change Healthcare, Quest, Healthix. Zero user reviews.

FindEMR listing. Built on Oracle 11g. Targets small-medium practices, primary care, ASC, behavioral health, addiction treatment. Claims 4-star rating from 10 reviews but no reviews displayed. Lists scheduling, e-prescriptions, portals, telemedicine, billing.
Slashdot software listing. Zero user reviews. Lists appointment management, clinical charting, e-prescribing, HIPAA compliance, patient portal, telehealth, E/M coding. Pricing starts at $495/mo.
